Canonical composite chore subject with gated name-only one-off/recurring source; linked account aliases remain, while profile-only chores may use assigned_to null under the private gates. Explicit erasure clears identifying subject and sets a sticky tombstone; archive retains history. Schema/source is not profile activation, rotation/XP parity or runtime acceptance.

Existing dormant owner-verified account link contract. Never create a link through backfill, selected profile, matching name or email.
Existing deterministic compatibility mapping, not authentication or an active verified link. Explicit erasure removes mapping; no reconstruction of erased subjects.

Private expiring owner proof scoped to an existing stable same-household profile. No authority or completed identity is inferred from a challenge. Profile erasure cascades credential metadata; archive, revision changes, removal and incompatible links prevent confirmation. Never copy token hashes into shared DTOs or reconstruct erased subjects.

Explicit profile erasure cascades this consent row through its composite household FK. Preserve canonical chore/pickup history under its own erasure rules; never transfer acceptance to a different identity.
